response.sql: WITH order_counts AS (SELECT customer_id, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM Orders GROUP BY customer_id), shares AS (SELECT customer_id, order_count, 1.0 * order_count / SUM(order_count) OVER () AS order_share FROM order_counts), ranked AS (SELECT customer_id, order_count, order_share, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY CASE WHEN order_share IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, order_share DESC) AS share_rank FROM shares) SELECT customer_id, order_count, order_share FROM ranked WHERE share_rank <= 10 ORDER BY CASE WHEN order_share IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, order_share DESC, customer_id;
